snippet.title: Ishan Sharma
snippet.description:
I'm a YouTube creator with 2.1M+ subs making videos on upskilling, business and AI. The goal is to help people make a living doing what they love.

I also run MarkitUp, a marketing agency based in Bengaluru helping brands grow on social with organic and shareable content. MarkitUp has worked with 40+ brands, from individuals and startups to publicly listed enterprises in India and companies in US & UK.

I co-authored Unlocking Unicorn Secrets with a mission to uncover stories of 20 Unicorn founders in India, from childhood to building a billion dollar company. These include Ritesh Agarwal of OYO, Nikhil Kamath & Nithin Kamath of Zerodha, Ghazal & Varun Alagh of Mamaearth among others. The book was published by Penguin on 15th August 2023 and went on to become an Amazon Bestseller, selling over 10,000 copies.

I've also delivered 40+ speeches at colleges across the India including IITs, NITs and many more. I've also done corporate sessions on AI with brands like HP, Lenovo, etc.

snippet.title: Sabrina Ramonov 🍄
snippet.description:
Teaching 10 million people AI, for free. HIT SUBSCRIBE!

I will NEVER sell courses. I do NOT take money from AI companies. I will NEVER do coaching, consulting, paid communities, or paid speaking. I earn $0 from Youtube Rewards. I am NOT your AI guru.

At age 30, I sold my AI company, Qurious, for $10M+ as Founder/CEO to Pegasystems (NASDAQ:PEGA). Today, I only make money as the solo founder of Blotato.com (Automate Social Media with AI Agents). I use AI daily as an entrepreneur and operator, and I ignore most AI hype because I'm busy scaling my business. My background is Computer Science and Physics from UC Berkeley; yes, this means I'm an engineer, not an influencer.
